name: dvortsovs-skills
description: Personal library of reusable Claude Code skills for DataLens development, distributed as plugins so they can be installed into any checkout without committing them.

plugins.name: dvortsovs
plugins.description: dvortsovs's personal skill namespace. Ships stand-check (invoked as dvortsovs:stand-check, or on its own when the user asks to «проверить на стенде»): verifies the current change in a real browser on the developer's own DataLens dev stand — asks YC / YT and the auth file, resolves the stand address from dev-nginx/nginx.conf or the docker compose template, refreshes TVM for YT only when stale, stops every running stand, starts a fresh one, drives the UI with agent-browser, stops the stand and reports with evidence. More skills will be added here over time.
